environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task definition mounts an ephemeral tmpfs volume at /app/public/uploads with noexec flag (Linux mount option). The ECS task role has no S3 or external write permissions. An AWS CloudHSM cluster (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) is provisioned in the VPC with the HSM_VERIFY_ENDPOINT set to the cluster's PKCS#11 proxy running on localhost:2223. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with a custom rule that inspects request body content using a regex pattern set matching common webshell signatures (<?php, <%@, <jsp:, #!/) with action BLOCK, plus the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule overridden to 5MB. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the default seccomp profile applied (blocks execve from within uploaded file context). The container runs as non-root UID 1000 with read-only root filesystem except the tmpfs mount.

waf_rules: Custom regex rule: body inspection for webshell patterns (<?php|<%@|<jsp:|#!/) -> BLOCK
config.hsm_type: AWS CloudHSM FIPS 140-2 Level 3, PKCS#11 proxy on localhost:2223
config.container_security: non-root UID 1000, read-only rootfs, default seccomp profile
